candidates.title: The Window That Sang at Noon
story_beats: At the library courtyard, fox and rabbit discovered the clinic's glass window made a piercing tone each midday before the final ferry, leaving the stranded travelers waiting.
Fox attempted an immediate fix, but they padded the window frame but the sound continued; rabbit stopped the attempt before the situation worsened.
Rabbit examined the evidence and realized sunlight heated an exposed metal vent that vibrated against the glass; together they revised their plan rather than repeating the mistake.
With the stranded travelers watching, they installed a flexible spacer and checked the ventilation airflow, then explained the clue so their neighbors could prevent the problem next time.

candidates.title: The Message With a Missing Flash
story_beats: At the library courtyard, fox and rabbit discovered the harbor's rescue signal always lost its third flash before the final ferry, leaving the stranded travelers waiting.
Fox attempted an immediate fix, but they replaced the lamp bulb but the pattern stayed incomplete; rabbit stopped the attempt before the situation worsened.
Rabbit examined the evidence and realized a turning weather vane briefly blocked the beam on each rotation; together they revised their plan rather than repeating the mistake.
With the stranded travelers watching, they raised the signal above the vane and verified the full code offshore, then explained the clue so their neighbors could prevent the problem next time.

candidates.title: The Bridge That Rose Without Rain
story_beats: At the library courtyard, fox and rabbit discovered the floating footbridge lifted sharply each afternoon despite steady river levels before the final ferry, leaving the stranded travelers waiting.
Fox attempted an immediate fix, but they added ballast but the bridge still rose unevenly; rabbit stopped the attempt before the situation worsened.
Rabbit examined the evidence and realized air trapped beneath a repair pontoon expanded in the afternoon heat; together they revised their plan rather than repeating the mistake.
With the stranded travelers watching, they vented the pontoon safely and installed a pressure relief fitting, then explained the clue so their neighbors could prevent the problem next time.
